secrets.name: TWELVEDATA_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. TwelveData API key for live market/news data. Without it the backend runs on synthetic/paper data.

secrets.name: FINNHUB_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Finnhub API key for live news. Without it news endpoints use fallback data.

secrets.name: AI_OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Enables the OpenAI-compatible AI explanation layer. Without it the backend uses the deterministic explainer.

secrets.name: USER_SECRET_MASTER_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. 32-byte key (base64) used to encrypt stored broker provider secrets. Only needed to use the provider vault feature.
